So the procedures and committees by law dictates our handling of speakers at council and committee meetings.
Speakers on new items not already on an agenda are directed to the appropriate standing committee or governance and priorities committee where they're placed on the agenda as per the by law.
Request to speak for existing agenda items are tied to the item be that at committee or council.
And practice is that those items are moved to the beginning of the meeting immediately following procedure items such as consideration of minutes question period etc.
Where there are multiple items with speakers items are considered in order of their original placement on the agenda.
For example, agenda item seven will be considered prior to agenda item 11 if they both have speakers listed on the agenda.
For items with multiple speakers speakers are listed in the order request were received by the city clerk's office.
Each item on the agenda is fully completed right up to the decision of council prior to moving on to the next item.

Public hearings are handled differently as there's the ability for both pre registration of speakers as well as for anyone in the gallery to make a presentation at the time the item is being considered.
In this case speakers pre registered are listed on the agenda and speak first followed by those present in the gallery but not pre registered.
Agenda items that public hearings are considered in the order they are listed on the agenda.

We do appreciate that there's times when there are multiple items with multiple speakers and lengthy discussion occurs on items which leads to long wait times for speakers.
